verdict.rationale: Maritime runs each agent in its own micro-VM from any Docker image you supply, so you can install arbitrary packages at build time via a Dockerfile. Its persistent Linux desktops can be driven with keyboard and mouse, which implies shell access, but the pack never documents an exec or shell-command capability directly. Missing for 10: a documented API/CLI/SDK command for running arbitrary shell commands in a running sandbox, documented runtime package installation, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
